theater: 廣東新會厓山崖門水道

battle.name: 厓山之戰
battle.theater: 廣東新會厓山崖門水道
battle.brief: 元至元十六年（1279）二月，漢軍統帥張弘範率舟師追至廣東新會厓山崖門水道，圍住宋帝昺的水軍。宋軍以鐵索連環船與樓船結陣自守，元軍以火船、火箭夾攻，並用西域工程師所造的回回砲——即卡面這件配重投石車——把石彈擲上宋舟，樓船中彈起火。張世傑突圍，丞相陸秀夫負幼帝投海，南宋亡。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 此役交戰的兩方是元（蒙古）與南宋，戰場在廣東新會厓山一帶的崖門水道，珠江出海的最後一道口門。元方由世祖忽必烈坐鎮大都，中書省與樞密院調度，江南行省以及泉州、揚州、廣州三處的水軍與船戶編入舟師，漢軍將領張弘範、董文炳、劉深、張興霸、李庭各領一軍；舟師之中另配西域回回砲手，襄陽歸附的舊部與沿海徵來的船工、漁戶同在編制之內，用於操舟、望哨與嚮導。宋方在臨安出降之後攜帝室浮海，於福州、潮州一線重整朝綱，以右丞相張世傑總水軍，丞相陸秀夫掌政，端宗與宗室、將佐分乘舟師，護駕退入厓山。兩軍的處境都不妙：元軍舟船大半新造，水手上手不久，遠征千里之後人馬俱疲；宋軍則糧秣不繼、久無援兵，士氣與裝備都靠臨時湊數。命令系統一邊出自大都的文書，一邊出自流亡朝廷的檄移，兩套政權在同一日、同一處海灣裡各自下了死守與必殺的令。
countriesEn: The two parties in this battle were the Yuan (Mongol) empire and the Southern Song, and the field was the Yamen channel off Yashan in the district of Xinhui, Guangdong — the last opening of the Pearl River to the sea. On the Yuan side the supreme direction stayed with Kublai Khan in Dadu while the central secretariat and the privy council dispatched the troops; the fleets of the Jiangnan administration and of the three ports of Quanzhou, Yangzhou and Guangzhou were mustered into the armada, and Han commanders such as Zhang Hongfan, Dong Wenbing, Liu Shen, Zhang Xingba and Li Ting each led a division. With them travelled engineers of the Muslim western regions, together with the men surrendered at Xiangyang and the boatmen and fishermen recruited from the coast, all of them enrolled for the work of steering the ships, keeping the lookouts and serving as pilots. The Song court, after Lin'an had surrendered, carried the imperial house away by sea and reorganised at Fuzhou and Chaozhou, with the right chancellor Zhang Shijie taking command of the navy, the chancellor Lu Xiufu holding the civil side, and the former emperor Duanzong, princes of the clan such as Zhang Da and Zhang Hu, and the commanders all travelling by ship as they escorted the child emperor Zha Bing back to Yashan. Neither army was in good heart. Most of the Yuan hulls were newly built and their crews were unused to long service at sea, worn down as they were after a campaign of a thousand li; the Song had no grain, no relief, and an army held together by improvisation. One chain of command issued its orders from the documents of Dadu, the other from the proclamations of a court in flight, and on the same day, in the same bay, each gave the order to hold or to kill without quarter.
people: 宋方有兩個人決定了此役的走向。右丞相張世傑是護著朝廷從泉州、福州一路退到厓山的人，他熟稔海峽的潮汐、季風與暗礁，封鎖期間屢次出舟偵探，把元軍的來路與航線摸得一清二楚；抵禦之法也是他定的，舟與舟之間以鐵索相連成一片，舷側與甲板塗泥、覆濕氈以防火攻，高桅上搭樓、設木欄與走馬板，兵卒居高臨下以弩矢與火器射擊，令元軍的小艇與火船無從插入。左丞相陸秀夫是文官之首，隨軍護駕到最後，兵敗之日負幼帝昺投海，以自己的性命結束了這場戰役。元方的主帥是漢軍統帥張弘範，他追宋的理由在奏議中說得很直白：宋相張世傑一日不除，國患一日不去。張弘範用兵老到，舟師抵崖門後不急著硬攻，先封海道、斷糧源，再候風潮擇時發動；副手李庭、張興霸分率舟隊準備兩翼包抄，另有回回砲手隨軍操作配重砲。忽必烈在大都遙領，屢下詔書催促必竟全功。
peopleEn: Two men on the Song side shaped the course of the battle. The right chancellor Zhang Shijie was the man who had brought the court from Quanzhou and Fuzhou all the way to Yashan; he knew the tides, the monsoons and the shoals of the strait, and during the blockade he sent craft out again and again to scout until he had the Yuan approach and their line of march mapped. The plan of defence was his as well: ship was lashed to ship with iron chains so that the formation had no gaps, the sides and the decks were smeared with clay and covered with wet felt against fire, and on the tall masts rose platforms with wooden rails and running boards, from which the soldiers shot down with crossbow bolts and fire weapons, so that the Yuan light craft and fire ships could not work their way in. Lu Xiufu, the chancellor, was the head of the civil officials and followed the court to the last; on the day of the defeat he carried the child emperor Zha Bing into the sea and ended the battle with his own life. The Yuan commander was Zhang Hongfan, leader of the Han Chinese troops. His reason for pursuing the Song was put plainly in his memorial: as long as chancellor Zhang Shijie lived, the trouble would never be at an end. Zhang Hongfan was an old hand; when his fleet reached the Yamen channel he did not strike at once, but sealed the sea road, cut the grain, and then waited for wind and tide. His lieutenants Li Ting and Zhang Xingba held the wings ready to envelop, and Muslim engineers travelled with the fleet to work the counterweight engines. Kublai ruled from Dadu and pressed for the work to be finished with imperial rescripts.
kits: 卡面這件配重投石車是歐洲十二世紀成熟的技術：一支長臂，末端兜住石彈，另一端懸著配重石，兩端同時落下時把石頭甩過城牆，比靠人力絞索的拋石機快得多。厓山一役真正出現在戰場上的配重式投石機，是元軍的回回砲——由西域回回工匠所造，自襄陽攻戰一路沿用到崖山，架在元軍船上與岸上，把石彈擲向宋軍樓船；元代文籍記其石彈重百五十斤，一擊而宋舟破碎，這是卡面兵器在這場戰役中最貼切的一段。與之相對，宋軍手上的投射武器是弩砲與弓矢：床弩、橐車弩列在船舷射擊，長弓補隙，火箭與火球用於焚燒逼近的敵舟；防護上，舟舷與甲板塗泥覆氈，高桅上架樓設欄，舟與舟以鐵索相連成連環船，樓船甲板鋪板以防火燒。兩造舟師的常規武備相去不遠，真正拉開距離的是元軍多了一套成熟的配重砲，加上船上火攻的手段。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is a technology that was mature in twelfth-century Europe: a long arm with a pouch at the end to hold the stone, a counterweight hanging at the other, and both ends falling together so that the stone is thrown over a wall — far faster than the traction engine worked by human ratchets. The counterweight engine that actually stood on the field at Yashan was the Yuan 'Muslim trebuchet', the huihui pao, built by craftsmen from the Muslim western regions, carried forward from the siege of Xiangyang and set up on the Yuan ships and on the shore to throw stones at the Song towers; the Yuan records give the weight of its stone as a hundred and fifty catties and say that a single shot broke a Song hull, and that is the passage in which the weapon on the card fits this battle most exactly. Against it the Song had crossbows and bows: bed crossbows and waggon crossbows ranged along the gunwales, long bows filling the gaps, with fire arrows and fire balls used to burn enemy ships that closed in. On the defensive side, the sides and decks were smeared with clay and covered with felt, platforms and rails were built up the tall masts, and ship was chained to ship in a single linked line, with plank laid over the decks of the great towers against fire. The ordinary weapons of the two fleets were not far apart; what separated them was the Yuan possession of a mature counterweight engine and of the means to set ships on fire from the water.
tactics: 元軍的作戰分三段。第一段是封鎖：舟師自泉州出海，經福州、潮州抵崖門，先以小艇巡弋、封死西江出海的水道，招降沿海岸的漁戶與船戶，切斷宋軍從高州、廣州一線取得糧食、淡水與援兵的通道；宋軍被壓在厓山海灣裡，糧盡之後取海水作飲，士氣與體力一齊塌落。第二段是待機：元軍不急著強攻，等風向與潮汐都對自己有利，才把舟隊列成前鋒、中軍、後隊三路，擇順風、潮漲的時辰發動。第三段是總攻：以火船順流直衝宋軍連環船的正面，火箭與弓弩同時覆蓋，張弘範自領中軍逼近，李庭、張興霸分率兩翼舟隊包抄宋軍側後，架在船上的回回砲把石彈投向宋軍樓船；宋軍的連環船在火攻之下不能轉向，樓船被石彈擊中起火，前後船隻互相牽連，陣腳一亂便再也收不回來。宋軍曾以弩砲反擊、以衝鋒小艇試圖截住火船，但元軍舟隊咬住不放，終於把宋軍中央的旗艦逼入死角。張世傑最後整軍突圍，帶殘部往南衝出。
tacticsEn: The Yuan operation had three stages. First the blockade: the fleet left Quanzhou, worked along the coast past Fuzhou and Chaozhou to the Yamen channel, and then patrolled with light craft to close the water road where the West River runs out to sea, while the coastal fishermen and boatmen were won over, cutting off the Song supplies of grain, fresh water and relief from the Gaozhou and Guangzhou coast. The Song army was pinned in the bay of Yashan, and when the grain ran out they boiled sea water to drink, and morale and strength went down together. Second, the waiting: the Yuan did not force an attack, but waited until the wind and the tide both favoured them, then drew the fleet into vanguard, centre and rear, and chose the moment when the wind was fair and the flood rising. Third, the general assault: fire ships were sent down the current against the front of the Song chain of hulls, rockets and arrows covered the ships at the same time, Zhang Hongfan led the centre in close, Li Ting and Zhang Xingba took the two wings to envelop the Song flanks and rear, and the counterweight engines standing on the hulls threw their stones at the Song towers. The linked Song ships could not turn under the fire, the towers were struck and set alight, hull for hull dragged on the next, and once that formation had broken it could never be closed up again. The Song answered with crossbows and tried to run down the fire ships with light craft, but the Yuan fleet held on and finally drove the central flagship into a corner. Zhang Shijie gathered what was left of his command and broke out to the south.
data: 可核對的數字不算多，各書口徑也略有出入。兵力方面，元代文籍與波斯史家朱韋尼所記略有出入：大船約五百艘，另有小艇數百乃至千艘；宋軍方面則記為戰船千餘艘、將士二萬餘人，其中多為收攏的潰兵與水手，另有隨船的朝廷官屬。器械方面，回回砲石彈重百五十斤這一個數字在元代文獻中反覆出現，可作當時的可靠記述；宋軍的連環船以鐵索相連，一列縱長達數百步，樓船高十餘丈，上設木欄數層。時間方面，元軍抵崖門封鎖在帝昺即位之後，決戰則在至元十六年二月六日，前後封鎖約兩個月。地理上，厓山在今江門新會崖門，崖門水道是西江與潭江匯流後的出海口，寬處不過數里，兩岸有虎門山、黃茅山一帶的丘陵，潮流每日兩漲兩落，冬春之際東北風多，順東南風出海最省力。損失方面不記雙方全滅之數，只說宋舟蔽海、張達與張虎浮海而死，而元軍收降的宋官將士以千計。這些數字都出自事後追述，宜作量級看。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are few, and the books differ slightly. On strength, the Yuan records and the Persian historian Ata-Malik Juvayni do not quite agree: some five hundred large ships, with several hundred and in some accounts as many as a thousand smaller craft; on the Song side the record is a thousand odd fighting ships and more than twenty thousand soldiers, most of them rallied stragglers and sailors, with the officials of the court travelling aboard. On equipment, the weight of the stone of the Muslim trebuchet — a hundred and fifty catties — is repeated in the Yuan literature and may be taken as a reliable contemporary figure; the Song chain of ships was held together with iron links and ran for several hundred paces in a single line, and the towers stood more than ten zhang high with several tiers of wooden rail. On time, the Yuan fleet reached the Yamen channel after the child emperor had been enthroned, and the decision was fought on the sixth day of the second month of the sixteenth year of the Zhiyuan era, after a blockade of about two months. On geography, Yashan lies at Yamen in Xinhui, Jiangmen, where the West River and the Tan River meet and open into the sea; the channel is at its widest only a few li, with the hills of Humenshan and Huangmaoshan on either bank, the tide making twice on the flood and twice on the ebb, and the north-east wind common in winter and spring, so that running out to sea on a south-east wind was the easiest way. Casualties are not given as a total for either side: the Song hulls are said to have covered the water, Zhang Da and Zhang Hu are said to have gone down swimming, and the Song officials and soldiers taken by the Yuan are put at some thousands. These are all figures written down after the event and are best read as orders of magnitude.
cause: 元宋打了近半個世紀，最後把南宋逼到海上的是一連串的失敗。襄陽、樊城於一二七三年陷落，一二七六年臨安出降，宋廷與帝室倉皇南走，此後在福州、潮州、廣州沿海輾轉；元廷並不打算讓宋室苟延，一二七八年之後派遣舟師追擊，漢軍統帥張弘範奉命自泉州出海，理由說得很明白：張世傑一日不除，南宋一日不亡。分歧的焦點是宋朝不肯降，也不肯放棄海上的生路——流亡朝廷靠泉州、福州一帶的海商、漁戶與遺留的市舶物資維持，而元廷要的不只是臨安與兩浙的城池，更要徹底斷掉這條海上通路，掌控廣州到泉州、杭州到廣州之間的整條海岸與海道。於是厓山成了最後的攔截點：宋軍不守城而守舟，元軍不攻城而封海；再加上元朝在造船與投射武器上的積累，一場決定性的海灣對峙便在所難免。
causeEn: Between the Yuan and the Song there had been nearly half a century of war, and what finally drove the Southern Song out onto the sea was a chain of defeats. Xiangyang and Fancheng fell in 1273; Lin'an surrendered in 1276; the court and the imperial house fled south in haste and then wandered along the Fujian, Chaozhou and Guangzhou coasts. The Yuan had no intention of letting the Song house survive: from 1278 a fleet was sent in pursuit, with Zhang Hongfan ordered out of Quanzhou with the fleet, and the reason given in the orders was plain enough: as long as Zhang Shijie lived, the Southern Song was not finished. The point of difference was that the Song would not surrender and would not give up its living on the water. The government in flight lived on the merchants, the fishermen and the residue of the maritime trade of Quanzhou and Fuzhou, while the Yuan wanted not only Lin'an and the cities of the Two Zhe, but the whole coastal road from Guangzhou to Quanzhou and from Hangzhou to Guangzhou, and the sea lanes with it. Yashan was therefore the last point of interception: the Song chose to hold ships rather than walls, the Yuan chose to seal the sea rather than to storm a city; and with what the Yuan had built up in shipbuilding and in engines of projection, a decisive confrontation in a bay became unavoidable.
impact: 厓山的結果是整個南宋的終結。宋朝自九六〇年建國，至一二七九年亡，歷三百一十九年，其中在江南的半壁江山維持了一百五十餘年；此後中原與江南同屬一朝，南宋一代的市舶、鹽鐵與軍費制度隨之改寫。元廷在南方沿海的做法與北方不同：一方面把泉州推為最盛的對外貿易口岸，與西亞、波斯、阿拉伯的商船往來頻繁，海外的航海、醫藥與工藝知識隨之流入；另一方面把沿海船戶、漁民編入官籍與水軍編制，海上秩序從此收歸國家，水師與海運合為一體。中國的攻城技術也在此役前後被改寫：西域工程師帶來的配重砲經襄陽一路推到崖山，把巨大的石彈送到城牆與樓船頭上，威力遠勝靠絞索人力發動的拋石機；這套技術後來為明軍繼承，成為中國攻城戰的標準配備，直到十五世紀仍有改良之議。精神層面上，厓山成了南宋最後的座標，陸秀夫負帝投海的場面與文天祥被俘後的詩作一起被後世反覆書寫；宋亡之後抵抗並未立刻停止，沿海一帶的抗元武裝活動了數年。今日新會的崖山仍稱象山，山上有宋元海戰的遺址與紀念祠堂，附近海域歷年出水宋元沉船與外銷瓷，成為理解這段海上交通的實物庫。
impactEn: The result of Yashan was the end of the whole Southern Song. The Song had been founded in 960 and was extinguished in 1279, three hundred and nineteen years in all, of which more than a hundred and fifty were spent holding the half country south of the river; from then on the central plain and the south belonged to a single dynasty, and the arrangements for maritime trade, for salt and iron, and for the financing of the war that the Southern Song had built were all rewritten. The Yuan governed this southern coast differently from the north. On one hand they made Quanzhou the busiest of the foreign trade ports, with constant intercourse between the ships of West Asia, Persia and Arabia, and navigational, medical and craft knowledge came in from overseas with them. On the other, the boatmen and fishermen of the coast were enrolled in the registers and in the naval establishment, so that order on the sea passed into the hands of the state, and the fleet and the sea transport were merged into one. Chinese siegecraft was also rewritten in the course of these years: the counterweight engine brought by engineers from the western regions went from Xiangyang on to Yashan, throwing great stones up against walls and against the decks of towers, and it was far more powerful than the traction engines worked by manpower; the Chinese later took it over, and it became the standard equipment of a Chinese siege, and there were still proposals to improve it as late as the fifteenth century. In the sphere of memory, Yashan became the last coordinate of the Southern Song, and the scene of Lu Xiufu carrying the emperor into the sea was written and rewritten together with the poems of Wen Tianxiang after his capture; resistance did not stop at once with the fall of the Song, and armed bands along the coast carried on for several years. The hill at Yashan in Xinhui is still called Xiangshan, with the sites of the battle and a commemorative shrine on it, and the waters nearby have given up year by year the wrecks of Song and Yuan ships with their exported porcelain, a store of hard evidence for the maritime traffic of these years.
result: 元軍大勝，宋軍主力全滅。決戰之日，元軍三路舟隊合圍，火船衝擊、火箭覆蓋、回回砲擊毀宋軍樓船，宋軍中樞的旗艦陷入火海，陣形崩解；張世傑收拾殘部突圍南下，據記載其舟行至海陵遇大風，舟覆而身死。宋軍的宗室與重臣多隨舟沉沒，丞相陸秀夫負幼帝昺投海，昭慈謝氏亦與之俱沒，張世傑之侄張達、張虎浮海而死者數百餘人；餘眾或降或散，張弘範所俘宋官將士以千計，檻送大都。史家通常把這一天算作南宋的終點，與此前一年半的臨安出降合起來看，元滅宋的戰事至此全部結束。回頭看，這場戰役的勝負關鍵不在任何一條船，而在三樣東西：封住海道的耐心、順風順潮的時辰，以及把石彈送到宋軍頭頂上的那幾門回回砲。配重投石車在歐洲十二世紀已是成熟技術，在中國則隨著蒙古人的征服由西域工程師帶入，作為一套攻城機器在襄陽與崖山這兩處最難啃的地方各打了一次；它改變的是攻擊的速度與體量，而不是戰爭的性質。
resultEn: The Yuan won decisively and the Song fleet was destroyed. On the day of decision the three columns of the Yuan fleet closed in, fire ships charged, rockets swept the ships, and the Muslim trebuchets shattered the Song towers; the central flagship of the Song went into the sea on fire and the formation came apart. Zhang Shijie gathered the remnants and broke out to the south, and it is recorded that his ship was caught by a great wind off Hailing, turned over, and he was drowned. Princes and ministers of the Song went down with the ships; the chancellor Lu Xiufu carried the child emperor Zha Bing into the sea, and the lady of the Zhao clan of Zhaoci went with him; the nephews of Zhang Shijie, Zhang Da and Zhang Hu, are said to have died swimming, with several hundred others. The rest surrendered or scattered, and the Song officials and soldiers taken by Zhang Hongfan are put at some thousands and were sent to Dadu in cages. Historians usually take this day as the end of the Southern Song; taken together with the surrender of Lin'an eighteen months earlier, it closed the war between Yuan and Song. Looking back, what decided this battle was not any single ship but three things: the patience to seal the sea road, the moment when wind and tide were right, and the few Muslim trebuchets that put stones over the heads of the Song. The counterweight trebuchet was a mature technology in twelfth-century Europe; in China it arrived with the Mongol conquest, carried in by engineers from the western regions, and it fought twice on the hardest ground of that war, at Xiangyang and at Yashan. What it changed was the speed and the weight of the assault, not the nature of the war.
